div.l: WYth hym ther rood a gentil pardoner
Of rouncyuale hys frend ⁊and hys comper
That streyght was come fro the court of Rome
Ful lowde he song come hyther loue to me
Thys sompnour baar to hym a styf burdoun
Was neuer trompe of half so greet a soun
Thys pardoner had heer as yelow as wex
And smothe it hyng as doth a stryke of flex
By hounses hyng hys lockis that he hadde
And there wyth hys sholdris ouer spradde
But than it lay by Culpous one and one
An hood for Iolyte wered he none
For it was trussed vp in hys walet
Hym thoughte he rood vp on the newe get
Dyssheuyld saue hys cappe he rood al bare
Suche glarynge eyen hadde he as hath an hare
A vernacle hadde he sowyd vp on hys cappe
Hys walet beforn hym had he in hys lappe
